create_instances_aws_ecs: create multiple AWS ECS container instances with commands and environment variables using AWSContainerService
create_single_instance_aws_ecs: create a single AWS ECS container instance with a command and env vars using AWSContainerService
get_instances_by_id: get multiple container instances by their IDs with automatic batching for AWS API limits
cancel_instances_aws_ecs: cancel multiple running AWS ECS container instances by their instance IDs
get_cluster_instance_info: get the current ECS cluster instance details including pending and running task counts
